settings_registry_capture_capture_clicks: A ring on each click in screen recordings and GIFs.
settings_registry_capture_capture_copy_d: Put every capture on the clipboard as soon as it is taken: screenshots as an image, recordings and GIFs as the file.
settings_registry_capture_capture_corner: The corner of the display under the pointer where the quick access cards stack.
settings_registry_capture_capture_dismis: Seconds before the card goes away by itself, 0 to 60. 0 keeps it until you close it.
settings_registry_capture_capture_enable: Turn the capture hotkeys on or off. Off gives the keys back to other apps.
settings_registry_capture_capture_hide_i: Hide the icons on the desktop while a screenshot or recording is taken.
settings_registry_capture_capture_highli: Show the pointer and a ring on each click in screen recordings and GIFs.
settings_registry_capture_capture_histor: Open, reveal or remove from the list your recent captures. Removing never deletes the file.
How many captures to remember, 1 to 500. Older ones drop off the list; their files stay.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_al: One toolbar over the screen: pick region, window, screen, record, GIF or text.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_fu: Capture the whole screen under the pointer.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_gi: Pick an area and record an animated GIF.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_oc: Drag over text on screen and copy it, read on this Mac.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_pr: Capture the same area as your last region capture, right now.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_re: Pick an area and record a video. Press the key again to stop.
Drag to pick an area, or press Space to switch to picking a window.
settings_registry_capture_capture_key_wi: Click a window to capture it.
settings_registry_capture_capture_keystr: A pill with the keys you press at the bottom of the recorded area. macOS asks for Input Monitoring the first time.
settings_registry_capture_capture_microp: Your voice goes into the video. macOS asks for microphone access the first time. Not in GIFs.
settings_registry_capture_capture_on_rel: Take the shot as soon as you let go of the selection; turn off to adjust it first and confirm with Return.
Capture when the mouse is released
settings_registry_capture_capture_permis: Screen Recording lets Atlas see the pixels of other apps. It is only used when you press a capture hotkey; nothing is recorded in the background. After granting it, macOS asks you to restart Atlas.
settings_registry_capture_capture_preset: Start from a ready-made set of keys. Picking one shows what it changes; nothing is saved until you apply it.
settings_registry_capture_capture_qualit: Lower qualities record fewer pixels, so the file is smaller. GIFs are not affected.
settings_registry_capture_capture_quick_: A small card with the capture: copy, save as, annotate, send to an agent, or drag it into another app.
settings_registry_capture_capture_scale_: Retina saves the display's own pixels; Standard saves one pixel per point, a smaller file.
settings_registry_capture_capture_sound_: A shutter sound when a screenshot is taken.
settings_registry_capture_capture_stack_: How many quick access cards stack in the corner before the oldest goes, 1 to 8.
settings_registry_capture_capture_system: The sound your Mac plays goes into the video. Not in GIFs.

macOS answers {screen}, {area}, {toolbar} and {touchBar} before any app, so Atlas can only use them once you turn them off yourself in System Settings ▸ Keyboard ▸ Keyboard Shortcuts ▸ Screenshots. Atlas never changes that setting for you.
settings_registry_capture_capture_timer_: Wait this long after you pick before a screenshot is taken. Recordings are not delayed.
settings_registry_capture_capture_window: A window capture sits on a padded background instead of a shadow. It wins over the shadow when both are on.
A window capture keeps its drop shadow, on a transparent background.
settings_registry_capture_description: Screenshots and screen recordings from a hotkey: where they go, the keys, and your history.
